law: THE GRAMMARS OF RECORD of the fee extraction [L-D.18] — DATA, tracked, read by `tierc12_data.py --manifest`: per venue the pattern that locates the entry tier's label (`entry_tier_label`), optionally the pattern whose named group `row` holds the entry tier's own text (`scope`), the patterns that locate its USDT-margined maker and taker figures (`maker`, `taker`; each with the named group `pct`), the sha256 of the saved body it was written against (`body_sha256`) and the AM-<n> id that ruled it (`amendment`). A venue's grammar is REQUIRED only when its capture returned HTTP 200 (then --manifest HALTs without one); a venue whose capture returned no body has no bytes to fix a grammar against and its entry is null.
proposal: reported by the TC12-D builder as an amendment proposal (AM-D-FEE-BINANCE_USDTM / AM-D-FEE-BYBIT_V5_LINEAR): there is no pattern to rule — neither page was retrieved with the library's default headers, so the maker pin of both venues is the figure on file (README.md), flagged NOT RE-CONFIRMED
